verdict.rationale: Render's own workspace webhooks let you choose service events (such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down) that send callbacks, which can then trigger custom actions in third-party services or your own Render apps. It also deploys automatically on every push. However, there is no documented rules engine for writing condition-to-action rules inside Render; the action logic must live in the receiving system. missing for 10: a first-party rule/condition editor for event-to-action automation, built-in actions beyond outbound notification and push-to-deploy, depth of event filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can configure *webhooks* for your Render workspace to notify other systems when specific service events occur (such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down)
Use webhooks to trigger custom actions in third-party services (chat platforms, CI/CD, etc.) or in your own Render apps.
Connect your repo and ship with every push.
